title: Device UX · final (decided 19 Nov)
intro: Claude Design round 2, canvas “Clubmate · Device UX”, page r2. The user picked A · Fold into the bar plus B's reading mode, Wiki as its own tab, Docs removed, sections as a native Liquid Glass TabView; then accepted dropping the iPhone Macs screen (workspace capsule + Inbox tray) and Search over the current workspace. Rules: rules.md next to this page.

iPhone: Agents · Backlog · Wiki · More + Search tab; bars and the tab bar minimize on scroll; wiki pages fold their header and enter reading mode; the permission card folds to a 56-pt row; the question card follows the Question card fold ruling (peek · full · bar). Cross-section jumps push with a named back chip. iPad: sidebarAdaptable TabView, columns step down (all · list + detail · detail) with ⌃⌘S, reading view on ⌃⌘F, wiki tree in the list column, docs open in the detail column.
